answer: Depreciating bonds make hoarded identities bleed every epoch. Each identity buys a 120-unit bond that pays no yield and loses 4% per epoch; only real work refreshes it to par, and the bond is the vault of reputation. A clone army cannot sit idle: 1,000 bonds cost 120,000 units and shed 4,800 per epoch, so ten idle epochs burn 40,000. Below 60 units residual the identity is demoted; forgery forfeits half the bond plus a 6-epoch refresh freeze. Like saffron losing scent in storage, a stored identity decays: the attacker's pulse must beat with genuine work, or it rots.
